semiconductor_relevance: High — NTT Advanced Technology Corporation specializes in nitride semiconductor epitaxial wafer manufacturing, which is critical for power devices in the semiconductor industry.
summary: NTT Advanced Technology Corporation focuses on manufacturing nitride semiconductor epitaxial wafers, contributing to energy conservation and low-carbon technologies. They offer capabilities from small-scale prototypes to mass production, accommodating various substrate types including silicon and gallium nitride.
capabilities: Crystal growth on silicon, sapphire, silicon carbide, and gallium nitride substrates
